question: Should ClawHub add a first-class SKILL.md capability manifest for skills, and what schema, authority model, and advisory-to-required rollout should it use?
rationale: This would become part of the public skill trust boundary; automation can verify the gap but cannot choose the permanent schema or enforcement posture without maintainer security/product intent.

options.title: Adopt advisory manifest first
options.body: Define the schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-vs-observed mismatches before requiring it for submissions.

options.title: Defer to scanner inference
options.body: Keep env/install metadata plus ClawScan coherence review as the only source of truth, accepting that authors still lack a declared baseline for these boundaries.

options.title: Require manifests immediately
options.body: Make new submissions provide the capability block from day one, gaining a stronger contract but requiring a stricter legacy and false-positive policy now.

recommendation.title: Adopt advisory manifest first
recommendation.body: Define the schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-vs-observed mismatches before requiring it for submissions.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses CODEOWNERS-listed schema, moderation, scanner, security documentation, and publish-check paths where this handle is the strongest routing signal.
